Article Title: 'Every corner of world but Bengal': State government's new tourism ad gets trolled
Article Text:
West Bengal tourism ad

NEW DELHI: The West Bengal government's state tourism ad was trolled by netizens after it failed to include anything that represents Bengal apart from the Howrah bridge.The ad was released on Friday by chief minister Suvendu Adhikari during a public event. "Hon'ble Chief Minister Shri Suvendu Adhikari attends the grand unveiling of West Bengal Tourism’s new brand identity, organized by the Department of Tourism, Government of West Bengal," the BJP state unit said posting video of the event.Though the ad begins with Howrah bridge, it progresses into showing Eiffel Tower, the Pyramids and several other world tourist attractions.TMC MP Derek O'Brien reacted to it calling it "Tacky. Trashy. Thooo.""Where is West Bengal in this?What kind of tourism logo reveal is this?? It is more like promoting international tourism rather than promoting Bengal! Everywhere but Bengal. Ridiculous," said a social media user Barnali Bairagi.Another user Joy said: "Let’s start with the bare minimum - The Background Music. With plethora of instruments available and tools to create OG music, they come with this trash that can put anyone to sleep (Play it on loop if u can’t sleep).The visuals and the shoddy video. It shows Howrah Bridge and moves on to deserts, pyramids, places that are not in West Bengal. Ya, the brilliant idea would have been to convey the experience of all the best things in the world u will find in West Bengal or something like that. ""All they had to do is just study the communication and visual story telling of Kerala Tourism. Or even Odisha Tourism. Rajasthan Tourism also at one point of time had done great communications. The tagline: Where India feels different is so generic, it can be placed anywhere. It can even be the Tagline of an amusement park. Or a residential project. It doesn’t evoke any emotion. Compare it with Kerala tourism’s - God’s own Country.Or Rajasthan’s - Padharo Mhare Desh. Which is such a welcoming and warm tagline," the user added.Another user requested the CM to "ask the tourism department to create a fresh, professionally conceived, Bengal-centric campaign showcasing our mountains, forests, rivers, Sundarbans, coastline, heritage, literature, music, cuisine, festivals and extraordinary cultural diversity.""There was a time when Bengal Tourism meant Darjeeling, the Toy Train, Sundarbans, Howrah Bridge, trams, Jhau dance, heritage, culture and the unmistakable soul of Bengal. The “Sweetest Part of India” campaign showcased Bengal as Bengal," Diptangshu Chaudhury said."Bengal doesn’t need borrowed landmarks to attract the world. It needs the imagination and competence to showcase what it already has. From Darjeeling to the Sundarbans, from the Himalayas to the Bay of Bengal—Bengal itself is the advertisement. Please don’t make Bengal invisible while trying to sell it," the person added.
Article Summary: The ad was released on Friday by chief minister Suvendu Adhikari during a public event. Though the ad begins with Howrah bridge, it progresses into showing Eiffel Tower, the Pyramids and several other world tourist attractions.

Article Title: From oratory to screen time, PM & teachers exchange notes
Article Text:
The interaction with National Teachers Award winners was held at PM Modi's Lok Kalyan Marg residence

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: "You need confidence and plenty of practice." That was the public-speaking advice PM Narendra Modi received from a national award-winning teacher during an interaction that moved from a joke about his "aura" to screen addiction, drug abuse and the need to preserve childhood.Modi had asked the teacher what she would advise him if he were her student and wanted to become a good orator. After her tip, she said, "Sorry, sir. Seeing your aura, my aura went down a little."The interaction with National Teachers Award winners was held at Modi's Lok Kalyan Marg residence Friday, the eve of Teachers' Day.One teacher said she was teaching children how to conduct interviews like journalists. Students had begun questioning their parents at home: "Why was this food cooked? Why was it cooked this way? Who made the decision? How much was spent?" She added, "All the children in my school now want to become reporters."Modi asked teachers not to judge children only by their academic performance. A child might struggle with studies but possess another ability, he said. Modi said children were naturally curious and teachers should nurture and guide that curiosity.Calling excessive screen time a form of addiction, the PM said children could be drawn away from phones by making them develop an interest in sports - "not video games, but playing on the field" - and creative activities.Teachers should speak to parents about how much time their kids spent on screens.On drug abuse, Modi said the problem was not confined to large cities and universities. Teachers must spread awareness, watch out for behavioural changes, and help those affected.When a teacher spoke about educating women on breast cancer, Modi referred to a similar awareness campaign in Varanasi, his Lok Sabha constituency. He said more women were now coming forward for check-ups and that a Guinness World Record had been set for the highest number of screenings in a day.Referring to National Education Policy, the PM urged teachers to take learning beyond classrooms. Children should be connected with real-world skills and taught values like the dignity of labour."The biggest contribution teachers can make is to keep childhood alive in students," the PM added.
Article Summary: The interaction with National Teachers Award winners was held at Modi's Lok Kalyan Marg residence. Modi asked teachers not to judge children only by their academic performance. Teachers must spread awareness, watch out for behavioural changes, and help those affected.

Article Title: Census 2027 enumeration advanced in four poll-bound states
Article Text:
Centre advances census 2027 enumeration in four poll-bound states

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Centre has decided to advance the population enumeration phase of Census 2027 in Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Punjab and non-snow-bound areas of Uttarakhand — given that all four states are due for assembly polls early next year — to the time period December 1, 2026 to January 4, 2027, with January 5, 2027 as the reference date. This will be preceded by a 15-day self-enumeration window in the four states from November 16 to 30, 2026.The first phase of Census in Manipur, which is also due for assembly polls in February-March next year, was recently postponed in view of demands from within the state to hold the national register of citizens (NRC) exercise first.The advancing of the population enumeration phase in the four other poll-bound states will avert the logistical challenges that may have arisen on account of a clash between the usual timeline for census and the assembly elections. Both elections and census rely on the same pool of govt employees — largely teachers — for their conduct.Conventionally, the second phase of census — involving population enumeration — is held countrywide, other than in snow-bound areas of a few states/Union territories, in the month of February, with March 1, as the reference date.The population enumeration phase in the snow-bound areas of Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and the whole of Ladakh is currently underway and will be completed by the end of this month."The conduct of Census of the population shall be undertaken in the states of Goa, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and areas other than snow-bound areas of the State of Uttarakhand, from December 1, 2026 to January 4, 2027 with a revisional round from January 5, 2027 to January 9, 2027,” the home ministry stated in a notification issued late on Saturday.Five states — Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa and Manipur — are set to go to polls in February-March next year. While the term of the Manipur assembly is expiring on March 13, 2027, that of Goa assembly ends on March 14, 2027; Punjab assembly on March 16, 2027; Uttarakhand assembly on March 28, 2027; and Uttar Pradesh assembly on May 22, 2027.Census 2027, apart from being the first 'digital' census, will capture 'caste' for the first time since 1931.
Article Summary: Census 2027, apart from being the first 'digital' census, will capture 'caste' for the first time since 1931. Five states — Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa and Manipur — are set to go to polls in February-March next year. Both elections and census rely on the same pool of govt employees — largely teachers.

Article Title: 'Step beyond books to connect with children': PM Modi's message on Teachers' Day
Article Text:
PM Modi meets National Teachers Awards winners

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has urged teachers to “step beyond textbooks” to ensure that children do not lose out on their childhood.The prime minister's message came during his interaction with recipients of the National Teachers’ Awards at his residence on Friday, a day ahead of Teachers’ Day, which commemorates the birth anniversary of former President and renowned educationist Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan."We need to step outside of books and the syllabus much more than before and get into the lives of children. Childhood shouldn't be allowed to die. And the biggest task of keeping childhood alive can be done by a teacher. It's the teacher's job to ensure the child within remains," he said.To drive home his point, PM Modi cited growing screen addiction among children, particularly their increasing dependence on video games. He also flagged drug consumption as a concern, saying the problem was no longer confined to universities or major cities."Screen time has now become a form of addiction. A thought occurs to me: if a child begins to take a keen interest in sports, and by sports, I don't mean video games but actually playing on the field. Then slowly, they can come out of it. And we should make it a habit to involve kids as much as possible in creativity, and we should design some programmes for that," the prime minister said."Now take the case of drugs. It's not just in big cities or universities anymore, nobody even knows what it is; someone just comes and gives it. Teachers should watch for behavioural changes in children," he added.Saturday marks the 138th birth anniversary of Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, who also served as Vice President of India. Later in the day, PM Modi will visit Shri Ram College of Commerce, which is celebrating its centenary.
Article Summary: PM Narendra Modi urges teachers to ensure children do not lose out on their childhood. He cites growing screen addiction among children, particularly their dependence on video games. Saturday marks the 138th birth anniversary of Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, who served as Vice President of India.

Article Title: "Dam did him bad": Salahdine Parnasse stunned Dan Hooker in his UFC Paris debut as fighters react to a performance that changed everything
Article Text:
Salahdine Parnasse (Image via IG/X)

Salahdine Parnasse turned one opening against Dan Hooker into a brutal first-round finish

Salahdine Parnasse now has the attention of the lightweight division after his UFC arrival

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Salahdine Parnasse could hardly have asked for a better UFC debut. Fighting Dan Hooker in the main event of UFC Paris, the French star needed only one round to make his presence known. His finish impressed fighters watching from outside the Octagon, while Parnasse quickly showed that he has much bigger ambitions for his UFC run. What happened in Paris was more than a debut win. It was an arrival that immediately changed the conversation around him.Parnasse entered the UFC with plenty of attention already around him. The promotion had trusted him with a main-event spot in Paris, giving him a major opportunity in front of his home crowd.There was little time for him to settle in.The opening exchanges were measured, with both fighters using kicks and looking for openings. Parnasse did not appear interested in forcing the finish. Instead, he stayed composed and waited for Hooker to give him an opportunity.That moment arrived with a damaging body kick.Parnasse landed cleanly to Hooker's midsection, and the New Zealander immediately showed that the shot had affected him.Parnasse recognized the opening and moved forward. A head kick followed before the Frenchman unleashed a fast series of punches.Hooker could not find a way out.The referee stepped in at 2:35 of the first round, giving Parnasse a knockout victory in his UFC debut.The result was especially impressive because Parnasse managed to finish an experienced opponent without allowing the fight to become a long, difficult battle. He showed patience before suddenly switching gears when the opening appeared.That detail stood out to former UFC fighter Alan Jouban.Jouban reacted to the performance on social media, writing: “Wow. impressive performance. Patient, methodical and when he decided to go was able to finish it. #UFCParis”Jouban's reaction captured what made the finish stand out. Parnasse did not spend the entire fight chasing a knockout. He waited, found the right moment and then attacked with speed.Terrance McKinney also had a strong reaction to what he saw from the French newcomer. “Damn did him bad Parnasse welcome to rankings and the ufc 👏👏👏”McKinney's comment reflected the bigger conversation developing around Parnasse. A debut victory is one thing, but a first-round knockout over a respected UFC veteran can immediately change expectations.Belal Muhammad was already looking toward the next matchup. “Aight he’s getting Michael Chandler next”The comment added Michael Chandler to the growing list of possible opponents for Parnasse and showed just how quickly the conversation moved beyond his debut.The reactions painted a clear picture of the impact Parnasse's performance had. Jouban focused on his patience and timing. McKinney saw a fighter who had already done enough to enter the rankings conversation. Muhammad was already thinking about who could be next.For a newcomer, that is a significant shift.Parnasse was not finished making his intentions known once the fight ended.During his post-fight interview, the Frenchman made it clear that he wants to move quickly through the lightweight division. He said he was ready for a top-five opponent before naming Max Holloway as the matchup he wants most.Parnasse spoke about Holloway with clear respect, calling him a legend while insisting that he is ready to share the Octagon with him.The callout gives the UFC an interesting decision.Holloway has years of experience at the highest level and has faced some of the biggest names in the sport. A fight with Parnasse would therefore be a major step up for the Frenchman after only one UFC appearance.At the same time, Parnasse's performance gave him a strong argument for being tested against a recognizable opponent.Michael Chandler is another possibility after Muhammad's reaction. Chandler would present a different challenge, particularly because of his explosive wrestling, power and experience in high-level lightweight fights.The UFC may ultimately decide that Parnasse needs another fight before entering the top-five picture. One victory is still only one victory, even when it comes against an experienced fighter like Hooker.But Parnasse has already made one thing difficult to ignore.He does not look like a fighter who intends to spend years quietly climbing the UFC ladder.His journey to the promotion was already unusual. Parnasse had previously turned down opportunities to join the UFC before eventually making the move. When the opportunity finally came, he was placed directly into a major main-event spotlight in Paris.He responded with a finish that lasted less than three minutes.Now, the attention has shifted to what comes next.The reactions from Jouban, McKinney and Muhammad showed that Parnasse's debut was not viewed as just another UFC victory. His performance gave other fighters a reason to start discussing him immediately.That is perhaps the biggest change coming out of UFC Paris.Parnasse arrived with questions surrounding how quickly he could adjust to the UFC level. He left with those questions replaced by a different one: how far can he go from here?His first UFC fight could have simply been an introduction.Instead, it became a statement that has put Parnasse firmly on the lightweight division's radar.
Article Summary: Salahdine Parnasse made his UFC debut against Dan Hooker in the main event of UFC Paris. The Frenchman turned one opening into a brutal first-round finish. His performance immediately changed the conversation in the lightweight division. Belal Muhammad, Michael Chandler and Max Holloway are all potential opponents.

Article Title: “That is the only thing that I have fallen short of”: Michael Page gets honest after his UFC Paris win revealing what he feels has been missing all along
Article Text:
Michael Page (Image via IG/X)

Michael Page feels he has fallen short of the “wow factor” that made him famous

Michael “Venom” Page’s UFC Paris win showed he can still adjust when the fight does not go his way

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Michael “Venom” Page walked away from UFC Paris with another win, yet the result carried more meaning than a number on his record. The British striker defeated Nursulton Ruziboev by unanimous decision after a difficult start. It was a solid performance from the veteran, though it did not bring the spectacular finish that has long been associated with his name. That makes Page’s earlier admission about his UFC career even more revealing.Page did not arrive in the UFC without a reputation.Long before making his promotional debut in 2024, he had already become one of the most recognizable fighters outside the organization. His Bellator career was built around an unusual striking style, quick movement and the ability to produce finishes that could leave fans stunned.The results have been respectable too. Page had lost only once in his first five UFC fights before facing Ruziboev. His defeat came against Ian Machado Garry in a razor-thin decision, while wins over Sharabutdin Magomedov and Jared Cannonier added some major names to his record.Still, Page has not been completely satisfied with the way his UFC story has developed.When asked if he was disappointed, the 39-year-old gave an unusually honest answer.“Yeah, it's definitely disappointing. It is a lot more difficult when you do not understand how you have gotten to this place because you do not know what you can change.”For Page, the frustration is not simply about his losses. He believes his performances have not always carried the same impact as the fights that made him famous before entering the UFC.That is where his most telling admission came.“I feel like that is the only thing that I have fallen short of. Although most of my fights have been entertaining, I feel like I have fallen short of that wow factor that I was known for.”It is a striking admission from a fighter whose reputation was built around making people wonder what he might do next.Page knows the UFC is filled with elite competition. He also understands that spectacular finishes are not guaranteed.“Obviously, we are in a game where guys are super talented. We are at the highest division, so it is never going to be a home run all the time.”That reality has not stopped him from wanting more.He still wants to create the kind of moments that made him such a popular fighter in the first place.Ruziboev gave Page a very different test in Paris.The British fighter did not have everything go his way from the opening bell. Ruziboev was able to make things difficult early, forcing Page to adjust instead of allowing him to settle into an easy striking rhythm.Page responded as an experienced fighter should.He stayed composed, found his range and grew into the contest. The fight eventually went to the judges, with Page earning a unanimous decision victory.It was another important win.It also offered an interesting contrast to what Page had said before the fight.He had already identified his lack of aggression as something he wanted to change. Looking back at his previous performances, Page believed he could have pushed the action more instead of waiting for the perfect opportunity.“Yeah, I guess potentially you can have regrets in retrospect,” he said.“With fights, you can learn from them. Everything else you cannot really control.”His solution was clear.“The main side of it would be to have a bit more output in some of my fights so that would be really trying to go for the win by being a bit more bloodthirsty.”That mindset makes the Paris performance particularly interesting.Page won the fight without needing to force a finish. He showed patience and the ability to recover from a challenging start. Those are valuable qualities, especially against an opponent who can create problems in multiple areas.Yet the fight also showed why Page continues to talk about the missing spark in his UFC career.The spectacular finish never came.Instead, he earned his victory through adjustments, striking and control over the later stages of the fight.There is nothing wrong with that approach. Fighters at this level cannot chase a knockout at every moment and risk throwing away a winnable fight.For Page, however, the standard is different because of what he has already accomplished.He knows what it feels like to produce moments that fans remember.He knows how quickly one perfect strike can change a fight.That is the version of himself he is still trying to bring back to the UFC stage.The Paris victory showed that Page remains capable of solving problems inside the cage. It also showed that the issue he openly identified before the fight has not completely disappeared.Now Page is looking for that feeling that once made his fights impossible to ignore.For the veteran, perhaps that is the real challenge ahead. Not simply winning more fights, but finding a way to make those wins feel unmistakably like Michael “Venom” Page.
Article Summary: Michael Page feels he has fallen short of the “wow factor” that made him famous. The 39-year-old defeated Nursulton Ruziboev by unanimous decision in Paris. Page had lost only once in his first five UFC fights.

Article Title: Sophie Cunningham’s hilarious business idea with Diana Taurasi has fans imagining a WNBA yacht party
Article Text:
Sophie Cunningham. Image via: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect

Sophie Cunningham’s dream business has a Diana Taurasi twist

Sophie Cunningham’s growing profile beyond basketball

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Sophie Cunningham has found plenty of ways to keep WNBA fans talking, both on and off the court. The Indiana Fever guard recently shared an unexpectedly ambitious idea for her dream business, and it has little to do with basketball. Her plan involves a yacht, endless sunshine, drinks and one of the biggest names in WNBA history, Diana Taurasi.Cunningham was asked what kind of business she would create if she could team up with another WNBA player. Instead of naming a teammate or choosing something connected to basketball, she went in a much more relaxed direction.Her pick was Taurasi, the legendary former WNBA star who built one of the most decorated careers in women's basketball. Cunningham's reason for choosing her potential business partner was refreshingly direct."If you were going to start a business with another WNBA player, who would it be?""I like that," she says in response to the question.After taking a moment to consider the idea, Cunningham revealed that she would choose Taurasi and build the business around a yacht."Because she has the finances," Cunningham explains.The concept sounds less like a traditional startup and more like a floating vacation for basketball fans.Cunningham imagined spending time on a boat, either on a lake or out at sea, with good weather, drinks and plenty of opportunities to relax."And then, the business would be being on a yacht, on a boat, on a lake or on the ocean, drinks flowing, you're getting a nice tan. But, definitely, budget, not mine."The comment captures Cunningham's playful personality. Rather than pitching a serious investment plan, she leaned into the fun of imagining what life could look like if money and logistics were not a concern.The interviewer then compared the concept to the reality series "Below Deck," which follows crews working aboard luxury yachts."You guys can start your own 'Below Deck?'""I like that," she says, laughing. "Absolutely."While a WNBA yacht venture with Taurasi remains a fantasy for now, Cunningham's growing popularity has opened plenty of doors away from basketball.The Fever guard recently passed 4 million followers on Instagram, giving her an enormous platform beyond the court. That kind of reach can make athletes attractive partners for consumer brands, particularly when their personalities connect with fans.Cunningham has already stepped into that space through a partnership with Once Upon a Coconut, a coconut water brand. The collaboration fits naturally with her athletic career and public image, especially as hydration remains an important part of an athlete's daily routine.Her business interests may be developing, but the yacht idea stands out for a different reason. It shows the lighter side of Cunningham and her ability to turn a simple interview question into an entertaining vision.Whether it ever becomes reality is another matter. For now, the idea of Cunningham and Taurasi hosting fans on a luxury yacht is a fun glimpse at what might happen when two WNBA personalities decide to take their talents offshore.
Article Summary: Sophie Cunningham was asked what kind of business she would create if she could team up with another WNBA player. Cunningham chose Diana Taurasi, the legendary former WNBA star. Cunningham imagined spending time on a boat, either on a lake or out at sea, with good weather.

Article Title: “Tom, come over, cutie": Alix Earle’s Tom Brady romance gets its biggest update yet as influencer breaks silence on Netflix reality show
Article Text:
Tom Brady and Alix Earle (Image via Getty Images)

Alix Earle breaks her silence on Tom Brady relationship

Tom Brady and Alix Earle's romance follows her difficult breakup

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Alix Earle has finally offered her first public glimpse into the romance that had kept fans guessing for months. The 25-year-old influencer addressed her rumored relationship with Tom Brady on her new Netflix reality series, Earle Meets World. Rather than making a formal announcement, Earle kept things playful and vague, giving viewers just enough to understand that the two had grown closer.The moment came during the second episode of Earle Meets World, when Earle was rehearsing with her Dancing with the Stars partner Val Chmerkovskiy.His wife, Jenna Johnson, entered the studio and quickly picked up on the subject that had been following Earle in the headlines.When Johnson asked what was going on, Earle did not exactly confirm a relationship. Instead, she gave a coy response that suggested she was enjoying the new chapter of her life.“I don’t know what’s going on,” Earle responded. “I’m having fun.”Johnson then asked if the relationship was confirmed. Earle shrugged and again avoided putting a label on it.“No, I’m just having fun,” said Earle, coyly. “I know, a lot has changed since last time.”Johnson responded warmly before bringing up Earle's previous relationship with NFL player Braxton Berrios.“Love that for you,” Johnson replied. “How are you doing after, like, Braxton?”“I’m good,” replied Earle.Johnson then joked about Brady entering the picture, saying, “Then you were like, ‘Tom, come over, cutie,’ ” while pretending to make a phone call.The exchange gave viewers their clearest look yet at Earle's side of the story, even though neither she nor Brady has publicly defined the relationship.Rumors surrounding Earle and Brady began after they were seen together around New Year's Eve in St. Barths. The pair later crossed paths again during Super Bowl weekend, when social media footage showed them talking and dancing at a party.The speculation intensified after PEOPLE reported in February that a source described the pair as “hooking up.” Representatives for both Earle and Brady have not commented on the report.The timing also drew attention because Earle had recently ended her two-year relationship with Berrios. Their breakup came after a difficult period of long-distance dating, with Berrios focused on his NFL career and Earle working on Dancing with the Stars.Earle later spoke openly about how difficult the transition was for her. In a January TikTok, she admitted that being without a partner felt unfamiliar because she had spent much of her adult life in relationships.“I think I’ve just always had boyfriends. I was, like, a boyfriend hopper,” she said at the time. “This year, I’m gonna be dedicated to being OK with being alone. But I don’t know why I can’t do it. This is like growth or something, but I’m sad.”Earle also acknowledged that loneliness did not necessarily mean she was truly alone.“I feel like it just makes life feel so lonely, but it’s not, and I’m not lonely.”Now, with Earle Meets World giving audiences a closer look at her personal life, the Tom Brady chapter has moved from speculation into something she is willing to discuss, even if she is still keeping the details to herself.
Article Summary: Alix Earle has finally offered her first public glimpse into the romance that had kept fans guessing for months. The 25-year-old influencer addressed her rumored relationship with Tom Brady on her new Netflix reality series, Earle Meets World. The exchange gave viewers their clearest look yet at Earle's side of the story.

Article Title: "I'll never stop being proud": Randi Mahomes gets emotional over Patrick Mahomes’ stunning 27-year full-circle moment in Times Square
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes and Randi Mahomes (Instagram)

Randi Mahomes celebrates Patrick Mahomes' journey with a 27-year throwback

Patrick Mahomes' NFL journey gives Randi Mahomes plenty to celebrate

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Randi Mahomes had a full-circle moment in New York City when she spotted her son Patrick Mahomes on a giant Times Square screen. Nearly three decades after posing with her young son and her own mother, Randi returned to a very different picture of his life. This time, the boy beside her had become one of the NFL 's biggest stars, making the moment especially meaningful for his proud mother.The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback's rise has given his family plenty of milestones to celebrate, but Randi's latest post focused on something more personal than another football achievement.She shared two images side by side. The first showed Patrick as a child with Randi and his grandmother. The second showed Randi standing in Times Square in front of an advertisement featuring her son.The contrast between the photographs captured just how dramatically Patrick's life has changed. What began as a family photo 27 years ago eventually led to his face appearing on one of the world's most recognizable advertising landmarks.Randi summed up the emotion behind the moment in a short message:"27 years later and you ended up on one of the big screens," Randi wrote. "I'll never stop being proud of you."For Randi, Patrick's success also carries the memory of the years it took to get there. She has spoken openly about raising three children as a single mother and the demands that came with balancing work and family.Patrick entered the NFL in 2017, when the Chiefs selected him with the 10th overall pick. He quickly developed into the centerpiece of the franchise and has since won three Super Bowl titles and two NFL MVP awards.His path has not been without difficult stretches. The Chiefs missed the playoffs last season after finishing 6-11, ending a postseason run that had lasted for years. Patrick also suffered a torn ACL in December, forcing him into a long rehabilitation process.That makes Randi's Times Square post more than a celebration of fame. It is a reminder of the distance between Patrick's childhood and the career he has built.Randi has previously described the less visible side of raising her children while supporting Patrick's ambitions."People don't see the constant balancing act," Randi said. "You have to be the nurturer and the disciplinarian, the provider and the protector. You carry it all, and some days, that's heavier than anyone realizes."I missed a lot… school events, social outings, holidays. I worked long hours to make sure they had what they needed. That was the trade-off, but I'd do it again in a heartbeat."Now, with Patrick preparing for another season with Kansas City and working his way back from injury, Randi can look at that old family photograph and see how far her son has come.A child once standing beside his mother is now staring back from one of Times Square's giant screens. For Randi, 27 years made all the difference.
Article Summary: Randi Mahomes shared a 27-year throwback photo of her and her son. Patrick Mahomes is now one of the NFL's biggest stars. Randi has spoken openly about raising three children as a single mother. Patrick's success also carries the memory of the years it took to get there.

Article Title: Coco Gauff marks a $650 million business milestone as the tennis star keeps her focus on the 2026 US Open title
Article Text:
Coco Gauff's investments.(Image via Getty Images)

Coco Gauff, the 22 year old World number four, has been a force to be reckoned with on the court. Behind Carlos Alcaraz’s success lies a journey of family sacrifices, painful setbacks and difficult moments that tested his dream

Carlos Alcaraz and his family’s financial struggle in his early tennis years

The Guardian

The Guardian

Carlos Alcaraz’s injury struggle and mental battle in 2026

Carlos Alcaraz has reached the top of tennis, but his journey was not always easy. His family had limited money for his early tennis career, meaning they needed outside help to send him to tournaments. Years later, after becoming a Grand Slam champion, Alcaraz faced a different struggle when a wrist injury kept him out for almost five months in 2026. Those moments tested him in very different ways.Alcaraz grew up in a family where tennis was already important. His father, Carlos Alcaraz Sr., had also wanted to become a professional player, but he did not have enough money to take that dream further. He later worked as a tennis coach and administrator.When young Carlos began travelling for tournaments, his own family faced a similar problem. Tennis required money for coaching, travel and other costs, and the family could not pay for everything on its own.His early coach, Kiko Navarro, helped find support from Postres Reina, a local confectionery company in Murcia. According to, the company helped pay for Alcaraz’s trips to tournaments after Navarro asked for financial support.That help mattered because Alcaraz was still only a young player trying to build his career. He had the talent, but he also needed the chance to compete and improve.The support continued as he began travelling around Spain and Europe. His family also had to accept another difficult change when Alcaraz moved away from home to train at Juan Carlos Ferrero’s Equelite Sport Academy in Villena.Navarro toldthat the move was difficult for Alcaraz because he missed his friends and family in Murcia. He still returned home on weekends, but leaving the place where he had grown up was another part of growing into a professional player.Those sacrifices eventually opened the door to the career he has today.By 2026, Alcaraz was no longer a young player looking for an opportunity. He was a seven-time Grand Slam champion and had completed his career Grand Slam by winning the Australian Open.Then came another major test.A wrist injury suffered in April kept Alcaraz away from singles tennis for nearly five months. He missed the French Open, Wimbledon and other important tournaments. For someone used to spending much of the year competing, suddenly having to wait was difficult.The hardest part was not only the injury itself. Alcaraz toldthat the uncertainty around his return led to “intrusive thoughts” and was the most challenging part of his time away from the court.He finally returned to singles at the 2026 US Open, beating Roman Safiullin in straight sets. He then continued his title defence by defeating Wu Yibing and reaching the fourth round.The return showed how different his struggles had become. As a child, Alcaraz needed financial support to keep travelling for tournaments. Years later, he had everything a young player could dream of, yet an injury forced him to step away from the sport.His story is therefore not about having an unusually difficult childhood. It is about facing problems at different stages and continuing to move forward. The family support that helped him begin, along with his ability to deal with setbacks later, played an important part in bringing Alcaraz to where he is today.

Teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi took on senior India pacer Mohammed Siraj and hit him for three boundaries in a single over on Day 1 of the Duleep Trophy 2026 final between East Zone and South Zone at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai on Sunday.Opening the innings alongside Abhimanyu Easwaran, Sooryavanshi gave East Zone a fiery start in the first session. Former India bowling coach Bharat Arun has questioned the way Mohammed Shami has been treated by the current selection committee led by Ajit Agarkar , insisting that the veteran pacer still has plenty to offer despite being out of the national setup.Shami has not played for India since the Champions Trophy campaign in March 2025, when India went on to win the tournament. Since then, the 36-year-old has remained outside the national team despite putting together a series of strong performances in domestic cricket.His continued absence has fuelled speculation that Shami's international career could be nearing its end. However, Arun believes India should not have shut the door on one of their most experienced fast bowlers.Shami's omission has been particularly noticeable when Jasprit Bumrah has been unavailable, with the Indian management opting to invest in younger pace options rather than recall the experienced Bengal seamer.There was also a public exchange between Shami and Agarkar last year. After the selectors left Shami out of the Test squad for the series against the West Indies, Agarkar raised questions about the pacer's fitness.Shami responded by making it clear that he would not have been playing Ranji Trophy cricket for Bengal had he not been fit.With Shami continuing to perform strongly on the domestic circuit, Arun believes age should not automatically count against him.“They shouldn’t have closed the door on Shami. There is still plenty of cricket left in him. When someone is performing, age shouldn’t be a factor. You see his durability. It is an outstanding number for the kind of talent he possesses. It is actually befitting for Shami. 100 first-class matches with what he loves most, the red ball,” Arun told the Indian Express.Shami is currently representing East Zone in the Duleep Trophy final against South Zone in Chennai, giving him another opportunity to make his case with the red ball.East Zone captain Ishan Kishan has also noticed a different level of intensity from Shami during the current domestic season.Speaking ahead of the Duleep Trophy final, Kishan said the veteran pacer has shown a strong desire to make an India comeback and praised the effort he has been putting into his domestic cricket.“As a captain, looking at the effort, I felt very nice, because Shami bhai coming in, asking me for those extra overs to get the wickets, it always gives confidence,” Ishan said.Kishan added that Shami's attitude has stood out to him, particularly given that he is no longer a regular member of the Indian team.“Looking at Shami bhai this season, I feel he has been very different. I’ve seen him in the past, but his approach towards the game, his intensity, his energy has been very different. When you are not regularly playing for the Indian team and to again have that same kind of motivation for your domestic games, it is tough but I feel I see that hunger in him. I think he has that hunger and that motivation right now like he wants to do that comeback, he wants to be part of Indian squad again and which you can see in him," he added.The Duleep Trophy final has also provided Shami with another significant milestone.The East Zone pacer has featured in his 100th first-class match against South Zone in Chennai, adding another landmark to an accomplished career.Shami also played an important role in East Zone's semi-final victory over defending champions Central Zone, claiming three wickets in the second innings.

Article Title: Trinity Rodman's US Open moment reveals an old habit in sports broadcasting: introducing women by their relationships first
Article Text:
Ben Shelton and Trinity Rodman. Image via: Getty Images

Soccer player Trinity Rodman celebrates after her boyfriend Ben Shelton, of the United States, won his match against Hubert Hurkacz, of Poland, during the second round of the U.S. Open tennis championships Wednesday, Sept. 2, 2026, in New York. (AP Photo/Kirsty Wigglesworth)

Rodman's career does not need Shelton's name attached to it

FILE - Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman in action during the second half of an NWSL soccer match against the Portland Thorns FC, Friday, March 13, 2026, in Washington. (AP Photo/Terrance Williams,File)

Call Her Daddy

WAG

Not Gonna Lie with Kylie Kelce

This has happened before

Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman shoots as Seattle Reign FC midfielder Samantha Meza, right, looks on during the first half of an NWSL soccer match, Sunday, May 10, 2026, in Seattle. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Trinity Rodman was sitting in Ben Shelton's player box at the US Open on Tuesday when the cameras found her.The ESPN commentary that followed introduced her as “Trinity Rodman, also known as Ben Shelton's girlfriend, and also known as a member of the US women's national team.” The on-screen graphic was similarly arranged: “Ben's girlfriend & USWNT player. ”Rodman is, of course, Shelton's girlfriend. The two tennis and football stars made their relationship public in March 2025, after Rodman slid into Shelton's DMs. Shelton, 23, is one of American tennis's leading players, a left-handed power hitter who reached a career-high world No.5 in late 2025 and has already won four ATP titles in 2026, including the National Bank Open two weeks before the US Open.But Rodman has spent the better part of her career becoming recognisable without him.The 24-year-old is an Olympic gold medallist, an NWSL champion and the highest-paid women's footballer in the world. She is also the daughter of NBA Hall of Famer Dennis Rodman, another fact that has often followed her into introductions of her own.The ESPN description prompted a familiar reaction from fans online, particularly because there was no shortage of things from Rodman's own career that could have been used instead.“Geez… she is so much more than Ben's girlfriend,” one fan wrote.Another put it more bluntly: “Trin is an Olympic gold medalist, NWSL player and then Ben's girlfriend. In that order.”Rodman's football career began long before she became a fixture in Shelton's box.The Washington Spirit selected her No.2 overall in the 2021 NWSL Draft when she was 18, making her the youngest player ever selected at the time. She won the league's Rookie of the Year award and helped Washington win the NWSL Championship in her first season.Three years later, she produced one of the defining moments of her international career.In the 2024 Paris Olympics final, Rodman scored in extra time against Japan as the United States won women's football gold for the first time since 2012. She now has 13 goals in 57 appearances for the USWNT.At club level, her value has grown just as quickly. Rodman became the first player signed under the NWSL's High Impact Player rule and agreed a landmark deal with Washington worth more than $1 million per season through 2028, making her the highest-paid player in the league.There is also the question of her surname, which has brought its own assumptions.Rodman has spoken openly about her complicated relationship with her father and rejected the idea that the name defines her.“He’s not a dad. Maybe by blood, but nothing else,” she said on“I love to have my last name and when I say Rodman, it’s not my dad’s name, it’s my name.”She has been less defensive about being known as Shelton's partner. In fact, Rodman has said she actually likes the term, even while acknowledging why some people dislike it.“For me, I think I like the term personally because, like I said before, I feel like 24/7 I'm on in front of cameras, and so I think I use the term WAG for me to simplify what I'm doing,” she said onin August.“For me, saying WAG, it's me being like, ‘I'm Ben's girlfriend.’ But I can understand why it's so hated.”She described being able to share that experience with Shelton as “the best feeling in the world”, pointing to the fact that both are constantly training, competing and exhausting themselves doing the sports they love.That distinction matters. Rodman choosing to embrace the label is not the same thing as it being the most useful way to introduce her.The US Open moment was not the first time Rodman's identity has been filtered through the people around her.At Wimbledon in 2025, she was introduced during one of Shelton's matches as “Tiffany” and had her father mentioned in the same breath.This time, the mistake was different. Her name was right, her relationship was real and her football career was acknowledged. Yet the order still said something: Ben's girlfriend first, USWNT player second.There was plenty of room for a different introduction.Rodman was not simply another celebrity sitting in a tennis player's box. She was an Olympic champion watching another elite American athlete compete at one of the biggest sporting events in the world.She can be Ben Shelton's girlfriend. She can be Dennis Rodman's daughter. She can even happily call herself a WAG.None of those things requires her own achievements to come second.At 24, Trinity Rodman has already built a career substantial enough to stand on its own. At the US Open, she happened to be there to support someone else.For once, she deserved the spotlight without needing to be introduced through him.
Article Summary: Trinity Rodman is an Olympic gold medallist, an NWSL champion and the highest- paid women's footballer in the world. The 24-year-old is also the daughter of NBA Hall of Famer Dennis Rodman. Rodman has been less defensive about being known as Ben Shelton's partner.

Article Title: Fatima Sana’s fiery Shafali Verma send-off draws savage response: ‘Your entire team just scored 55’
Article Text:
Fatima Sana

Pakistan batting collapse

India complete another one-sided win over Pakistan

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Pakistan captain Fatima Sana found herself at the centre of attention during her side’s Women’s Asia Cup clash against India at the Dubai International Stadium on Saturday.Sana did manage to make an impact with the ball, claiming three wickets as Pakistan were bowled out for just 55. But it was her animated celebration after dismissing India opener Shafali Verma that became one of the talking points of the contest.The incident occurred on the third ball of the second over of India's chase. Sana delivered a good-length ball that bounced slightly more than Shafali expected.The young opener attempted to work it towards the leg side but only managed to produce a leading edge. The ball went back towards Sana, who held on comfortably to complete the catch.Sana immediately turned towards Shafali and gestured towards the pavilion, giving the Indian batter a fiery send-off.Shafali, however, showed no reaction to the celebration and simply walked back towards the dressing room. She had made 12 off six deliveries, hitting one four and one boundary before her dismissal.The send-off also drew a sharp observation from commentator Vivek Razdan, who pointed out the contrasting fortunes of the two teams.“Okay, you are showing her the way out. Your entire team just scored 55 runs, and now you're sending Shafali Verma back,” Razdan said on air.Sana's dismissal of Shafali was her third wicket of the innings, as the Pakistan captain tried to lead from the front after her own team's disastrous batting display.Pakistan had initially appeared comfortable after being asked to bat first. Muneeba Ali and Shawaal Zulfiqar put on a confident start, taking the score to 27 without loss in a little over four overs.That progress quickly disappeared once India turned to spin.Youngsters Shree Charani and Prema Rawat dismantled the Pakistan middle order with disciplined spells, while Deepti Sharma also joined the attack as Pakistan lost six wickets for only nine runs.Charani, a 22-year-old left-arm orthodox spinner, finished with outstanding figures of 3/7 from four overs. Rawat, the 24-year-old leg-spinner, claimed 3/9 in her four overs.Shafali also contributed with the ball, picking up one wicket for 10 runs from three overs, while Deepti returned 2/5 from 3.1 overs.Pakistan eventually folded for 55 in 18.1 overs, their lowest-ever total in T20I cricket.India's bowlers were relentless throughout the innings, delivering an astonishing 78 dot balls.There was little drama once India began their chase.Shafali was dismissed for 12, while Smriti Mandhana made nine and Pratika Rawal scored four, with Sana accounting for all three wickets.But Pakistan had no scoreboard pressure to work with after their own collapse, and Harmanpreet Kaur and Deepti Sharma comfortably guided India home.Harmanpreet remained unbeaten on 18, while Deepti finished not out on 12 as India reached the target in only 8.4 overs to complete a seven-wicket victory.The result also gave Harmanpreet another landmark. She became the first captain in international cricket, men or women, to lead India in 150 T20Is.She fittingly sealed the victory with a six down the ground.India had entered the contest looking for some valuable match practice before the semi-finals, but Pakistan's batting collapse turned the fixture into another one-sided affair.The result extended India's dominance in the T20 Asia Cup, with the Indian women now having seven wins over Pakistan's one in the tournament's history.
Article Summary: Pakistan bowled out for 55, their lowest-ever total in T20I cricket. Shree Charani and Prema Rawat took three wickets each for India. Harmanpreet Kaur and Deepti Sharma guided India home.

Article Title: ‘Your alumni are the OGs’: PM Modi’s Gen Z shoutout at SRCC centenary celebrations
Article Text:
PM Modi lauds Shri Ram College of Commerce's landmark legacy.





NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi returned to Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) Saturday, 13 years after his widely discussed visit to Delhi University college, this time to mark its centenary celebrations.Reflecting on the institution’s legacy, he described its alumni as the “OGs” who had taken the SRCC name across the world and made their mark in diverse fields.“Aapki bhasha mein yahan ke alumni OG hain (In Gen Z terms, your seniors were OGs),” Modi said, referring to the college’s former students. He praised generations of SRCC students for excelling across fields, adding with a touch of humour: “Dhurandhar ho na ho, par dhoom machayi hai” (Whether they are stalwarts or not, they have certainly made a mark).He recalled former Union minister Arun Jaitley , an SRCC alumnus, saying he often heard stories about the college from him. “There was hardly a meeting when he did not narrate some incident related to SRCC,” Modi said, adding that Jaitley would sometimes repeat the same anecdotes.Describing the occasion as “very historic”, Modi welcomed generations of students and alumni associated with the institution. “The college’s journey began from a modest space in Daryaganj,” he said, adding, “Even now simply saying ‘SRCC’ is enough to make a statement within Delhi University.”As part of the event, he released a Rs 100 commemorative coin bearing the college’s name and logo, marking its 100-year journey.He also released two anthologies of poetry, one in Hindi and the other in English, featuring works associated with more than 200 alumni across SRCC’s history.“When a person completes 100 years, they are considered an ocean of experience. But when an institution completes 100 years, it becomes an ocean of achievements and inspiration,” Modi said.Crediting the institution with shaping generations of students, Modi said, “Those who came here studied, and those who left came out refined,” highlighting SRCC’s role in preparing students for professional and public life.Modi also revisited his 2013 address at SRCC, which he said continued to resonate after 13 years. “Whatever I said at that time was my conviction,” he said.Returning to one of the central images from that speech, Modi referred to a glass of water. He had presented three ways of looking at it—as half full, half empty, or completely full, half with water and half with air. Even during what he described as a period of widespread pessimism, he said, he chose to see the glass as full.He also recalled the enthusiastic response from students during his 2013 address. After speaking for some time, he asked if they wanted him to continue, and the audience urged him to carry on, he said.SRCC principal Simrit Kaur recalled Modi’s 2013 description of the college as a “vidya mandir” and “tapobhumi”, saying those words had acquired even greater meaning over the years. She also thanked the institution’s teachers for imparting what she described as the most valuable asset—knowledge.The Prime Minister’s return to SRCC was preceded by an interaction with students during a Delhi Metro journey earlier in the day.
Article Summary: PM Narendra Modi returned to Shri Ram College of Commerce to mark its centenary celebrations. He described its alumni as the ‘OGs’ who had taken the SRCC name across the world and made their mark in diverse fields. Modi also revisited his 2013 address at SRCC, which he said continued to resonate after 13 years.

Article Title: 2 coaches of Mahananda Express derail near Ara Railway Station
Article Text:
Two coaches of the Mahananda Express derailed near Ara railway station early Sunday morning (Photo credit: X)





PATNA: Two coaches of the Alipurduar-New Delhi Mahananda Express ( 15483) derailed near Ara railway station under Danapur division of the East Central Railway (ECR) in the early hours of Sunday. No passenger was injured in the incident.According to preliminary investigation, the incident occurred around 4 am when the loco pilot allegedly overshot a signal.After realising that the signal was not meant for his train, the loco pilot moved the train backwards towards the loop line following which two wheels of the coaches got derailed, ECR CPRO Saraswati Chandra said .Railway officials immediately rushed a rescue and restoration team to the spot.The affected track was cleared on priority and normal movement was restored after the coaches were attended to.The Mahananda Express resumed its onward journey at around 7.23am after completion of the necessary procedures, he said.Railway authorities have initiated a detailed inquiry to ascertain the exact circumstances leading to the derailment.Senior officials of the Danapur division are monitoring the situation and further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation, sources said.
Article Summary: Two coaches of the Alipurduar-New Delhi Mahananda Express derailed near Ara railway station under Danapur division of the East Central Railway (ECR) No passenger was injured in the incident. According to preliminary investigation, the incident occurred around 4 am when the loco pilot allegedly overshot a signal.

Article Title: Tirumala temple deputy executive officer M Lokanadham arrested in disproportionate assets case
Article Text:
Tirumala temple's deputy executive officer M Lokanadham has been arrested by ACB officials for holding disproportionate assets





TIRUPATI: Tirumala temple deputy executive officer M Lokanadham was arrested by Anti-Corruption Bureau sleuths in connection with a disproportionate assets case registered against him on Thursday.It may be recalled that ACB teams conducted raids at Lokanadham’s residence and multiple locations linked to him and unearthed movable and immovable properties, including 2 kg of gold, 6.5 kg of silver and Rs 12.5 lakh cash, all worth approximately Rs 5 crore and disproportionate to his known sources of income, on Wednesday.ACB sleuths continued their searches for the second consecutive day on Thursday before formally taking the Tirumala temple deputy EO into custody to produce him before the ACB court at Nellore and subsequently send him to judicial remand.The timing of Lokanadham’s arrest has come as a big jolt to the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams as the Tirupati trust finds itself less than two weeks away from the Srivari annual Brahmotsavams, slated to get underway at Tirumala from Sept 15.The Tirupati trust reportedly went into a huddle to quickly find a suitable replacement within the organisation to be appointed as the Tirumala temple deputy EO, as this is a crucial post linked to the smooth functioning of the day-to-day religious rituals held at the Tirumala temple as well as the annual festivals observed at Tirumala.Even as Devasthanams employees were yet to come out of the rude shock following the arrest of the Tirumala temple deputy EO, former TTD chairman Bhumana Karunakar Reddy questioned inconsistencies in the ACB narrative linked to the disproportionate assets case in which Lokanadham was arrested.Pointing out that amid the ongoing raids on Wednesday, ACB DSP Srinivasa Rao had told reporters that following a barrage of complaints received against Lokanadham, the ACB was carrying out raids in connection with the disproportionate assets case as per the court’s direction.Interestingly, in the final ACB press release issued later on Wednesday evening, the ACB took a completely different narrative, stating that the CBI, which completed its investigation into the laddu ghee adulteration case and filed a chargesheet, had shared some information about the disproportionate assets of some TTD employees with the ACB, AP.“In follow-up action, a Disproportionate Assets case was registered against K Chinna Appanna, Personal Assistant (PA) to the then TTD Chairman YV Subba Reddy. On further enquiry and collection of evidence, now a fresh disproportionate assets case was registered on Lokanadham U/s 13(2) r/w 13(1)(b) of the Prevention of Corruption (As amended in 2018) Act, 1988.”Bhumana wondered how there could be two versions from the ACB on the disproportionate assets case booked against Lokanadham.“It was way back in January that the CBI concluded the investigation in the Laddu ghee adulteration case and had also filed its final chargesheet at the Nellore court besides submitting a self-contained note with some recommendations to the state govt. Close to 7 months after that, the ACB note claims the CBI to have shared information relating to the disproportionate assets of some Devasthanams employees, which is quite bizarre to attempt to link up the laddu case investigation to the DA case booked on Lokanadham,” the ex-TTD chief observed.Bhumana demanded that the state govt disclose the information shared by the CBI with the ACB, if such information exists in the first place, especially after its futile attempt to enforce the “red book vindictive” action against certain Devasthanams employees in the TTD.
Article Summary: Tirumala temple deputy executive officer M Lokanadham was arrested by Anti- Corruption Bureau sleuths in connection with a disproportionate assets case registered against him on Thursday. ACB teams conducted raids on Wednesday and unearthed movable and immovable properties, including 2 kg of gold, 6.5 kg of silver and Rs 12.5 lakh cash, all worth approximately Rs 5 crore.

Article Title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus may have just told millions of professionals around the world that LinkedIn is 'not important' when you are ...
Article Text:
Limited information on Apple CEO John Ternus’ LinkedIn profile

John Ternus recently joined Twitter

Apple’s new CEO John Ternus may have just told millions of professionals around the world that LinkedIn is 'not important' when you are trying to reach the top of the tech industry. John Ternus became Apple CEO on September 1 after more than 25 years at the company, but his LinkedIn profile still does not list him as CEO. Instead, the profile identifies Ternus as Apple’s vice president of hardware engineering. It also leaves out much of his career at Apple, including his involvement with major products such as the Apple Watch and AirPods.For someone who has risen to lead one of the world’s biggest technology companies, his limited LinkedIn presence is notable.John Ternus’ LinkedIn page contains only a small amount of information about his professional career. It lists his time at Apple and a four-year stint as an engineer at Virtual Research Inc. The profile also mentions his mechanical engineering degree from the University of Pennsylvania. Apart from a profile picture and Apple as a followed interest, there is little else.Most notably, the profile has not yet been updated to show his new position as Apple CEO. Apple’s internal pages were updated immediately after Ternus took over from Tim Cook on September 1.While Ternus has not made much of his LinkedIn profile, he recently joined X (formerly Twitter). His first post was simply “hello.” The post had received over 81 million views and 523,000 likes as of the time of the report.Tesla and X chief Elon Musk replied to Ternu’s Hello post writing, “Congrats!"”before following up with an additional comment noting, “New Apple CEO posting on X”.Notably, Ternus currently follows only three accounts: Apple, Tim Cook and Apple senior vice president of marketing Greg Joswiak.
Article Summary: John Ternus’ LinkedIn page contains only a small amount of information about his professional career. Apart from a profile picture and Apple as a followed interest, there is little else. The profile has not yet been updated to show his new position as Apple CEO. Apple’s internal pages were updated immediately after Ternu took over from Tim Cook on September 1.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge
Article Text:
El Rubius reacted honestly after his elimination from MrBeast’s $1 million challenge, calling it “unfair” and claiming he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings. His response felt real and balanced, especially after MrBeast’s team later sent him a cake, softening the moment.

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

El Rubius did not just walk away from MrBeast’s $1 million streamer challenge. He opened up. Soon after his elimination, the Spanish creator shared a raw reaction with fans, giving them a closer look at what the experience felt like from inside the game. It was not polished or carefully framed. It felt real, and that is exactly why it caught attention so quickly.The clip and his response have since fueled conversations across the streaming space. Some viewers believe intense competitions like this naturally lead to uneven situations. Others feel Rubius may have had a point about being singled out. Either way, his words have added a human layer to a challenge that many only saw as entertainment.Speaking through an Instagram Story, Rubius did not hide his frustration, but he also made sure to thank his supporters. He said, "Guys, I just got knocked out of the game. It was a bit of an unfair elimination, but hey, at least I managed to walk away with $50,000 for you all, which I’ve already distributed. It went to the mods, the subs, and the non-subs alike."He further added, "I’m happy, of course, though admittedly, it was incredibly tough.I wasn't really a fan of the challenge itself, either. But then again... it was basically a three-against-one situation the entire time. I mean, they were targeting me specifically the whole way through. I kept trying to go after RaKai, but, well, he actually just got eliminated in the end. So, at least justice was served for Abraham. Abraham, if you’re watching this, we were all rooting for you, and standing right there with you."His message carried mixed emotions. There was disappointment, yes, but also pride in how he handled things. Giving away his $50,000 winnings to his community stood out as a gesture that meant more than the result itself.He continued with another honest note, saying, "And in the end, karma finally caught up with that little punk. Sorry, I’m being a bit toxic right now, but let's just hope the MrBeast team doesn't see this! Guys, thank you all so much. Seriously, thank you for all the support and for just being there."He added, "Every time I asked for something in the chat or whatever it was, you guys were right there. You’re incredible. I’m a little disappointed in myself, personally, mostly for not performing better, but hey, I gave it my all, and we still walked away with $50,000, so we’ve got to look on the bright side. All right, guys, big hugs to all my brothers out there!"Interestingly, the story did not end with frustration. Later that day, Rubius revealed that MrBeast’s team had sent him a cake after his exit. It was a small gesture, but it shifted the mood. It showed that even in a high-pressure challenge, there is still room for respect.In the end, Rubius’ reaction felt honest and grounded. That is what stayed with people.
Article Summary: El Rubius was eliminated from MrBeast's $1 million streamer challenge. He called it "unfair" and said he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings.

Article Title: "Trans women are.....": Clavicular’s viral moment with trans women sparks fresh conversation on internet culture
Article Text:
A viral clip featuring Clavicular and trans women is gaining attention for its calm and honest tone. The conversation explores how online language and trends move across communities. Instead of conflict, the exchange highlights shared influence and mutual awareness. Viewers are engaging with its thoughtful nature, as it reflects how internet culture evolves through collaboration rather than ownership.

Clavicular and trans women share a surprising realization about online trends

The video of Clavicular, a short-video producer, is going around the Internet, yet not the reason why. There is no yelling or over-the-top drama. It is a mere, everyday talk that seems almost novel nowadays, in the age of internet, which is overflowing with content. The scene is easy-going, the tone of the narrative is straightforward, and the characters appear more concerned with conversation than combat.The message that is being addressed is the flow of the conversation. It discusses internet culture, the way people communicate with one another and the place of trends. Rather than bringing out a debate, the encounter towards curiosity. It quietly brings attention to something that a lot of people who use the internet notice but don't often say out loud. People in different communities often have a bigger impact on each other than they think.The conversation begins with a confident and lighthearted comment from one of the trans women present. She says, "You know that trans women are like the OG lip masters, right? We are very talented in the program. Like, I do the peptides, I'm on Zeta." Her tone carries a mix of pride and humor, setting a relaxed vibe at the table.Clavicular responds in a way that keeps the mood steady but adds a different angle.He says, "That is funny because you guys were using a lot of the words in like the South Korean subreddits in like 2014." It’s not confrontational. If anything, it feels like an observation. He points to how certain words and ideas may have traveled across different online spaces over time.Another voice joins in and brings the moment full circle. "Guys, we're like the OGs. I saw a couple of posts about that. We're like copying each other." That line hits in a simple but honest way. It reflects something familiar. Online culture is rarely created in isolation. It grows through sharing, borrowing, and sometimes even unknowingly repeating.That's what makes the clip so powerful. It doesn't want to make a point or win an argument. It only shows a group of people talking, listening, and figuring something out together.This moment feels different in a space where viral content often leads to fights. It reminds people that conversations can be calm, thoughtful, and still important. And sometimes, that honest silence is what makes it work.
Article Summary: A viral clip featuring Clavicular and trans women is gaining attention for its calm and honest tone. The conversation explores how online language and trends move across communities. Viewers are engaging with its thoughtful nature, as it reflects how internet culture evolves through collaboration.
